The forced skill-1 arm proves set-188 miss bytes, zero-damage combat enrollment, and the unconditional three-pulse wait.
The legal arm proves set-188 hit bytes, damage routing, combat enrollment, improvement ordering, and the unconditional three-pulse wait.
